exp.1.summary: I deliver end-to-end IT support, combining strong technical troubleshooting skills with a proactive, customer-focused approach to ensure reliable systems and minimal downtime. I drive operational excellence through process improvement, cross-functional collaboration, technical project delivery, and efficient IT asset and vendor management.
exp.2.summary: Delivered end-to-end IT support to approximately 4,700 employees across corporate offices, call centers, and manufacturing environments, ensuring operational continuity through rapid troubleshooting, infrastructure management, and VIP support. Managed the full IT asset lifecycle, strengthened security and access management, and contributed to infrastructure projects, technical documentation, and reliable production operations.
exp.3.summary: Delivered dedicated IT support to exchange and trading floor personnel, maintaining the availability and performance of critical workstations and specialized trading equipment in a high-pressure financial environment. Minimized downtime through rapid hardware troubleshooting, proactive maintenance, and close collaboration with IT teams on upgrades, replacements, and business continuity.
